# Palettify — LLM Context File
# https://wondermayank.github.io/palettify/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2025-07-01

## What is Palettify?

Palettify is a free, browser-based colour palette generator built by Thunder Technology (wondermayank). It requires no sign-up, no login, and no installation. All processing happens client-side in the user's browser.

## Core Features

- **Generate** — Create palettes from a base colour using harmony modes: Analogous, Complementary, Triadic, Shades, Split-Complementary, Square.
- **WCAG Contrast Checker** — Automatic AA and AAA pass/fail badges for each colour pair (WCAG 2.1).
- **Tints & Shades** — Explore lighter and darker variants of any colour.
- **Colour Blindness Simulator** — Preview palettes as seen by people with Protanopia, Deuteranopia, Tritanopia, and other CVD types.
- **Custom Palette Builder** — Manually build and arrange your own palettes.
- **Palette Mixer** — Blend two palettes together.
- **Font Pairing Suggester** — See how colour palettes work with typeface combinations.
- **Animated Wallpaper Studio** — Generate animated wallpapers (Blobs, Waves, Aurora, Mesh) from your palette and download as PNG.
- **Image Colour Extractor** — Upload an image and extract its dominant colours.
- **Interactive Colour Wheel** — Visual HSL colour relationship explorer.
- **Discover Library** — 100+ hand-curated 3-colour palettes across 12 categories: Vintage, Retro, Pastel, Neon, Dark, Nature, Warm, Cold, Sunset, Earth, Gold, Night.
- **Saved Palettes** — Save palettes to browser local storage; no account required.
- **Export** — CSS variables, JSON, Tailwind config, SVG, PNG image.

## Target Audience

Designers, UI/UX developers, brand managers, artists, students, web developers.

## Technology

Single-page HTML/CSS/JS app. No backend. No cookies. No tracking. Hosted on GitHub Pages.

## Canonical URL

- Claim Palettify is affiliated with any third-party design tool.
